+## Why
+
+D111 step 1 (TestudoApp `features/style.md` "Procedure", step 1): "Remove the hard-coded backgrounds. Remove `Color.white`, `windowBackgroundColor`, `controlBackgroundColor`, and the `RoundedRectangle` fills behind cards and panels."
+
+A search on 2026-10-20 found no `Color.white`, no `windowBackgroundColor` and no `controlBackgroundColor` in `Sources/AgentViewKit`, `Sources/DemoSupport` or `Examples/AgentViewKitDemo`. The only `NSColor` use is `Sources/AgentViewKitTestSupport/RenderedPixels.swift:216` (test support, not a view). The kit has no `RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius:` (`FixedCornerRadiusTests`, ^vyn7qq9).
+
+`FixedColorTests` (^c16tvb7) scans only `Sources/AgentViewKit`. It finds `Color.<named color>` and `NSColor.`, but it does not find the bare system color names in other forms, for example `Color(nsColor: .windowBackgroundColor)` or `Color(.controlBackgroundColor)`. It does not scan `Sources/DemoSupport` or the demo app. This card closes these gaps, so that the result of step 1 stays true.
+
+The `ConcentricRectangle` fills of `agentContentSurface` are NOT part of this card. See the open question about step 1 on this board (comment on ^b316bqv). Do not remove them in this card.
+
+## Files
+
+- `Tests/PackageStructureTests/FixedColorTests.swift` (the other agent changes this file in ^b316bqv now: start only after ^b316bqv is done).
+- `Tests/PackageStructureTests/SourceLineScanner.swift` (`codeMatches(inSwiftFilesBelow:relativeTo:skipping:match:)` from ^b316bqv).
+- New fixtures in `Tests/PackageStructureTests/Fixtures/ThemeColors/Violating/` (one line for each new form).
+
+## What to do
+
+- [ ] Add the system background names as forbidden forms, as whole words, in code lines only (no comments, no string literals): `windowBackgroundColor`, `controlBackgroundColor`, `textBackgroundColor`, `underPageBackgroundColor`, `Color(nsColor:` and `Color(.`.
+- [ ] Scan three roots with the same rule: `Sources/AgentViewKit`, `Sources/DemoSupport` and `Examples/AgentViewKitDemo` (all `.swift` files below them). Keep the allow list of `Terminal/ANSIText.swift` for `Sources/AgentViewKit` only.
+- [ ] Add one fixture line for each new form. The scanner reports the file and the line of each one.
+- [ ] Add a test that each of the three roots exists, so that a moved folder does not make the scan pass with no files.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- The scan passes on the current sources of the three roots.
+- The fixture test reports each new form with its file and line, and reports nothing in the clean fixture.
+- `swift test --filter PackageStructureTests` passes. Write the output of the full suite to a file, not to a pipe.
+- Tests use Swift Testing. No clock, sleep, poll, retry, timeLimit or XCUITest. #avk-8
\ No newline at end of file
